page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.18xlarge is a storage-optimized server powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 72 dedicated vCPUs and 36 physical cores using Intel Xeon 8559C processors operating at 3.2 GHz. The CPU configuration includes a 320 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX for deep learning operations.

The server is equipped with 576.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, it bundles 45,000 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, making it highly suitable for data-intensive workloads. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 38 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the i7ie.18xlarge demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance and high memory bandwidth, with uncached read speeds reaching 287.15 GB/sec. It achieves top-tier results in static web serving throughput and image processing. Database operations and Redis SET performance are also strong, processing 91.92 million operations per second. These characteristics make the server highly efficient for large-scale databases, data warehousing, real-time analytics, and memory-intensive enterprise applications.
